# Quantum Mechanics and Relativity

## Abstract

This paper explores relativistic energy formulation as detailed by Einstein [1] and extended in quantum electrodynamics [Smith et al., 2020].

## Mathematical Formulation

The energy-mass equivalence formula is stated below:

$$ E = mc^2 $$

In 2D coordinates, the differential equation is:

\[ \nabla^2 \psi + k^2 \psi = 0 \]
